name: Android Development
description: Native Android apps with Kotlin and Jetpack Compose, MVVM architecture, local data, networking and Play Store release.

nodes.name: Coroutines & Flow
nodes.desc: Structured concurrency, suspend functions, dispatchers and Flow.

nodes.name: Studio & Gradle

nodes.name: App components
nodes.desc: Activities, intents, the manifest and the Android lifecycle.

nodes.name: Compose basics
nodes.desc: Composable functions, modifiers and layouts.

nodes.name: State in Compose

nodes.name: Lists & navigation

nodes.name: Material theming
nodes.desc: Material 3 components, colour schemes, typography and dark theme.

nodes.name: First Compose app

nodes.desc: Entities, DAOs, migrations and observing queries with Flow.

nodes.name: Networking

nodes.name: Notifications
nodes.desc: Notification channels, actions and push messaging.

nodes.name: DataStore & files
